name: Kesennuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kesennuma city emblem in blue and green: a blue and green swirl of two interlocking strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kesennuma, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2006.

features.role: Kesennuma city emblem — a blue and green swirl of two interlocking strokes
